scientific_modules.M1: frozen causal GADEN do(S=s) reachability through the run-persistent sensor, summarized as the hit count in each ordered three-stop source-update block
scientific_modules.M2: exact Bayesian filtering over a temporally persistent but evolving exchangeable transport latent

preserved_results.interpretation: V3 preserves a 49.4218 percent fixed-trajectory pooled development signal and 27 of 30 wins, but is NO-GO because whole-run fixed transport is not incrementally stable and one catastrophic regression remains.

frozen_dependencies.global_emission_matrix: the source-, House-, route-, truth- and outcome-independent Jeffreys-smoothed V3 4x4 Q fitted from ordered strict member-LOO pairs

state_definition.latent: Z_j in {0,...,7} is the exchangeable transport-realization state at source-update block j
state_definition.initial_distribution: uniform over the active predictive members
state_definition.time_unit: one physical source-update block containing exactly three newly completed stops
state_definition.forbidden_interpretation: member labels are not named meteorological regimes and no member-specific transition parameter may be fitted

transition_model.meaning: with probability rho retain the prior realization; otherwise redraw uniformly from the active exchangeable member set
transition_model.label_invariance: simultaneous permutation of transport-member labels leaves A, likelihood and posterior unchanged

persistence_estimator.domain: frozen simulation block counts only; no measured tape, native PMFS posterior, truth coordinate or localization error
persistence_estimator.matched_design: same House, candidate source, trajectory stream and adjacent source-update blocks
persistence_estimator.same_rows: indicator that the same transport member has equal block count across adjacent blocks
persistence_estimator.cross_rows: indicator that two different transport members have equal block count across the same adjacent blocks
persistence_estimator.interpretation: chance-corrected excess adjacent agreement attributable to retaining one simulated realization
persistence_estimator.LOO_rule: each held-out-member predictive premise fold estimates rho after excluding that member from every same and cross row
invalid_conditions: no eligible same or cross rows
any measured, truth, posterior or localization field is consumed
persistence_estimator.degenerate_boundary_rule: rho equal to 0 or 1 is reported; DYNAMIC then equals IID or FIXED and cannot pass the strict incremental Gate

exact_inference.carrier_posterior: normalize sum_m alpha_J(s,m) jointly over source and member
exact_inference.numerics: exact finite-state forward recursion with global positive rescaling after each block; no particle approximation, MAP state selection or beam pruning
exact_inference.online_batch_contract: prefix-online recursion must equal a fresh batch recursion to absolute tolerance 1e-12

arms.PMFS: native PMFS posterior and planner baseline
arms.M1_CAUSAL_ONLY: frozen V1 global-count causal reachability likelihood
arms.M1_M2_DYNAMIC_FULL: the exact dynamic-latent recursion at simulation-estimated rho
arms.M1_M2_TIME_SHUFFLE: same dynamic model and rho, with a deterministic nonidentity permutation of the observed block order for every prefix of length at least two

destructive_controls.time_shuffle: preserves each observed block count and its histogram while destroying temporal alignment
destructive_controls.iid_transport: destroys transport persistence while preserving Q and every candidate block prediction
destructive_controls.fixed_transport: forbids transport evolution and exactly recovers the V3 whole-run coherent-member model
destructive_controls.M1_only: removes M2 while preserving the causal physical evidence operator

premise_gate.independent_unit: House x historical route, exactly 30 clusters; member-LOO folds are averaged within cluster before inference

measured_fixed_trajectory_gate.independent_unit: one historical House-seed run, exactly 30 paired runs

catastrophe_definition: reuse the frozen V1/V2/V3 definition without modification
projection: reuse the frozen V2 hierarchical KL/I-projection; ABSTAIN is exact native PMFS
forbidden: threshold, temperature, blend, adaptive weight or posterior reset
House-, seed-, source-, truth- or outcome-specific persistence
changing Q, M1, planner, PMFS or source support
changing the method after any V4 result is read

terminal_policy.measured_gate_fail: CTT_DYNAMIC_TRANSPORT_TWO_MODULE_V4_NO_GO; stop and retire M2 while preserving M1
terminal_policy.all_pass: freeze M1+M2 and authorize exactly H01/H02/H03 seeds1-3 contemporaneous paired 300 s PMFS OFF versus frozen ON
